runtimeAdapters.equipmentStatScaleReason: Adapter for the native P2 scale: round each positive converted equipment stat to a whole point, with a minimum of one point; source raw values remain separately available.
runtimeAdapters.reinforcementFormula: For each destination level e: G=1/600; floor(inc*coef*e*(0.22+e*e*G)*qualityCoef*G + 5*e + 3*inc); double Bạc when e>=200. Sum e=current+1..target. Tranh Ngọc: 0 through e=200; 40*ceil((e-200)/10) through 260; e above 260.
runtimeAdapters.reinforcementDiscount: Wiki client text: account level >=200 reduces Bạc by 5%; >=300 reduces Bạc by 10%. Save v5 uses simulated mobileCommanderLevel as the account-level adapter; per-destination-level floor and that adapter are not source verified. Building/technology discounts have no published coefficients and are not applied.
runtimeAdapters.runtimeDropRoll: SOURCE_EXACT per-NPC item and rate; DERIVED_FROM_SOURCE independent P2 seeded roll using rate/100. Quantity is omitted by the source and defaults to one (SIMULATED).
runtimeAdapters.refinementActivation: UNRESOLVED: raw exact property pools are retained. Mobile Wiki client says rates are chances per roll, but slot 6 'so' sums to 1.10 and slot 7 'cao' sums to 1.08; runtime activation/cost and combat semantics require a source-consistent rule.
runtimeAdapters.unresolvedCampaignDrops: 12 rows have no unique item detail/resource binding (including id 0 'Sách Vạn Năng' and generic 'Nguyên liệu'); preserved but not granted.
